performance_intent: Adds the existing eight-digit fast scan to base-ten integer parsing; also changes an MSVC warning pragma
checked_scope: parse_int_string<uint64_t,char> and parse_int_string<int64_t,char> at base ten, exactly eight arbitrary input bytes followed by a safe sentinel, initial output value 123; value, error, and consumed position in both directions
limitations: No proof for other lengths, integer types, bases, character types, MSVC branch, or official historical before/after benchmark performance.
